design.affected_system: commercial curb, loading, delivery, and urban freight network
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy
pair land-use and event-conditioned curb demand forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Curb regulations, occupancy, deliveries, violations, and travel effects have consistent timestamps and locations.
Observed platform or sensor activity represents only its measured market and street coverage.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy.

constraints.description: The urban freight and curb operations forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: curb-management director and city freight coordinator
design.decision_question: What block-time loading and occupancy range should dynamic curb operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The urban freight and curb operations forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: land-use and event-conditioned curb demand forecasting

design.intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in delivery-minutes without legal loading capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast occupancy observed obstruction or illegal behavior.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for block-time freight loading demand and curb occupancy passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
